programme.title: Love's Unfolding Dream

Clark: Dale Midkiff. Missie: Erin Cottrell.

programme.title: Rock the House
programme.desc: A busy lawyer (Jack Coleman) struggles to make time for his teen daughter (Cassi Thomson), and their relationship suffers. But when the man reconnects with his high-school bandmates, he sees positive changes in everyone. Directed by Ernie Barbarash.

programme.title: Hidden Places
programme.desc: In 1930s California, a widowed farmer (Sydney Penny) tries to save her property from being seized by the bank with the help of a kindly drifter, who may be much more than he seems. Based on a novel by Lynn Austin.

programme.title: Reading, Writing & Romance
programme.desc: A struggling actor takes a job teaching high-school English and begins a romance with another teacher. But when he lands a big acting gig, he must decide if he's willing to leave behind his new life.

programme.title: Ladies of the House
programme.desc: Three women find solace in each other's company while rebuilding a home for their church's day-care program. The construction process proves therapeutic as they navigate their tumultuous personal lives.

programme.title: Late Bloomer
programme.desc: Botanist Jenny fled her small town and cruel high school couple Shane and Allison to track rare flowers around the globe. Now back, she's shocked to find Shane has become a teacher and even more surprised when he's determined to make it up to her.

programme.title: Honeymoon for One
programme.desc: A Los Angeles advertising exec travels to Ireland alone for her honeymoon after breaking things off with her dishonest fiancé. While abroad, she develops a connection with a local estate manager, but a conflict involving the woman's business threatens the budding romance.

programme.title: Shadow on the Mesa
programme.desc: A gunslinger seeks out the father he never met while looking for answers about his mother's murder. When he arrives at his father's ranch, he finds himself in the middle of a war over the land.

programme.title: Easy Heart
programme.desc: A music teacher hires a struggling country singer to perform at her town's annual festival, but the musician's difficult behavior causes problems. The pair soon find common ground in music, however, and inspire each other to embark on new paths.

programme.title: Secret Millionaire
programme.desc: A rich young man hides his identity when he discovers that he is taken by the passion of a woman who is protesting the dealings of his father's company. However, their relationship blossoms and is later on threatened.

programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: After a lawyer (Jeremy London) proposes to his girlfriend (Dorie Barton), they head to her family's ranch for the holidays, where he must gain approval from her difficult dad (James Gammon) and cope with her scheming aunt (Sally Struthers), who informs her niece's ex-flame of the blossoming relationship. Mark Griffiths directed.

programme.title: Mixed Baggage
programme.desc: When Evie Jones rushes off a flight to make her connection, she has no idea that in her haste, she has grabbed the wrong duffel bag.

programme.title: Sisters of the Groom
programme.desc: Jason ropes his neighbor Sarah into pretending to be his girlfriend for his brother's wedding but his prying sisters suspect something is amiss.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: A woman returns home to Texas after an eight-year absence to claim the ranch her grandfather left to her in his will. Unfortunately, she has to somehow bridge the generation gap when she finds herself at loggerheads with her father.

Jackie: Joanna Miles. Paul: David Selby. Estelle: Shelley Duvall. Carl: Frederic Forrest. Grace Ann: Roxanne Hart. Michael Lindsay-Hogg directed.

programme.title: Letter Never Sent
programme.desc: Henry discovers a love letter he wrote in high school to his best friend and attempts to share it to see if she feels the same way, but it ends up in her new boyfriends possession.

programme.title: Expecting a Miracle
programme.desc: Botched directions lead a struggling couple (Teri Polo, Jason Priestley) to a small Mexican town whose residents have a positive effect on the pair's faltering marriage. Cheech Marin and Rebeka Montoya also star. Directed by Steve Gomer.

programme.title: The Shell Seekers
programme.desc: Angela Lansbury is a widow searching for a meaning to her life in this teleplay adapted from Rosamunde Pilcher's novel. Olivia: Patricia Hodge. Nancy: Anna Carteret. Noel: Christopher Bowen. Antonia: Sophie Ward. Richard: Sam Wanamaker. Danus: Mark Lewis Jones. Cosmo: Denis Quilley. Dolly: Irene Worth. Roy: Michael Gough. George: John Rowe. Filmed in England and Spain.

programme.title: Woman of the House
programme.desc: A woman who feels nostalgic about her college sorority days takes a job as a house mother to her former chapter. Along with bringing out the best in the girls, she helps to turn the chapter around with the help of the charming Dean of Student Affairs.

programme.title: Love's Abiding Joy
programme.desc: In this drama based on the fourth book in Janette Oke's best-selling "Love Comes Softly" series, Missie and Willie LaHaye (Erin Cottrell, Logan Bartholomew) get accustomed to rugged frontier life, but tragedy threatens to shake up their stable family. Michael Landon Jr. directed.

programme.title: Bad Date Chronicles
programme.desc: Leigh runs the popular website 'Bad Date Chronicles' where daters can go to anonymously post horrible date experiences. When rival blogger Conner becomes the subject of one of her posts, they agree to date each other in order to prove which one is actually a bad dater.

programme.title: Fixing Pete
programme.desc: A fashion columnist (Brooke Burns) receives an assignment to make over a sloppy sportswriter (Dylan Bruno). As the pair spend time together, they learn from each other and sparks begin to fly. But romantic complications threaten to keep them apart. Directed by Michael Grossman.

programme.title: A Stranger's Heart
programme.desc: Samantha Mathis plays Callie, the recipient of a long-awaited heart transplant whose cynical attitude dissipates as she longs for a connection with her donor's orphaned daughter. Peter Dobson plays Callie's love interest and fellow transplant recipient, but it's Thomas Kopache who steals the show as her perennially grieving widowed father. Andy Wolk directed.

programme.title: Rock the House
programme.desc: A busy lawyer (Jack Coleman) struggles to make time for his teen daughter (Cassi Thomson), and their relationship suffers. But when the man reconnects with his high-school bandmates, he sees positive changes in everyone. Directed by Ernie Barbarash.

programme.title: Late Bloomer
programme.desc: Botanist Jenny fled her small town and cruel high school couple Shane and Allison to track rare flowers around the globe. Now back, she's shocked to find Shane has become a teacher and even more surprised when he's determined to make it up to her.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Neighbors form an unusual arrangement to share custody of a dog, and the pair soon find themselves falling for one another.

programme.title: Honeymoon for One
programme.desc: A Los Angeles advertising exec travels to Ireland alone for her honeymoon after breaking things off with her dishonest fiancé. While abroad, she develops a connection with a local estate manager, but a conflict involving the woman's business threatens the budding romance.

programme.title: A Son's Promise
programme.desc: Rick Schroder as the eldest of seven brothers, battling to keep his siblings together. Filmed in Georgia. Dorothy: Veronica Cartwright. Weston: Boyd Gaines. Paw Paw: Donald Moffat. Wayne: David Andrews. Tommy: Andrew Lowery. Charles: Stephen Dorff. Renolds: Ken Strong. Judge: Danny Nelson. David: Ryan Marshall.

programme.title: Playing Father
programme.desc: A jazz musician takes a teaching gig at a struggling school and mentors a talented but troubled student. As he helps the teen confront problems at home and school, he also begins to focus on healing his relationship with his own distant son.

programme.title: Do I Say I Do?
programme.desc: Author Jessica Bender is forced to work with her former boyfriend and editor Mike Pryce. During this association, the two ex begin to realize that the spark of their love is not yet completely extinguished.

programme.title: Hidden Places
programme.desc: In 1930s California, a widowed farmer (Sydney Penny) tries to save her property from being seized by the bank with the help of a kindly drifter, who may be much more than he seems. Based on a novel by Lynn Austin.

programme.title: Easy Heart
programme.desc: A music teacher hires a struggling country singer to perform at her town's annual festival, but the musician's difficult behavior causes problems. The pair soon find common ground in music, however, and inspire each other to embark on new paths.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Francis Ford Coppola's epic crime drama, starring Marlon Brando, Al Pacino and James Caan. In New York following the Second World War, Don Corleone is determined that his family should keep control of the American crime world. His daughter Connie is to be married, an occasion that draws guests pledging gifts to the couple in the hope that they will be granted favours by the "Godfather".

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: Epic crime drama starring Al Pacino, Robert De Niro, Robert Duvall and Diane Keaton. Michael Corleone is determined to legitimise the family business, but struggles to escape its violent past. With his leadership challenged by rival factions, Michael becomes increasingly obsessed with family loyalty, as he remembers his late father's first, challenging days in America.

programme.title: The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Francis Ford Coppola's finale to The Godfather saga, starring Al Pacino, Diane Keaton and Andy Garcia. New York, 1979: Michael Corleone wants out of his criminal empire in a search for respectability. But it's difficult to break with the family tradition. Inevitably, the tentacles of the old business prove all-embracing and powerful, with fatal consequences.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford and Karen Allen. Indiana Jones's outrageous exploits take him around the world in search of the legendary Ark of the Covenant, a religious artefact of unspeakable power wanted by the Nazis. With the help of an old flame, Indy takes on his enemies in a terrifying and death-defying battle to the finish.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Harrison Ford returns as intrepid archaeologist Indiana Jones in the second entry in Steven Spielberg's action adventure series. On the trail of fortune and glory in Shanghai, Indy is launched on a dangerous new quest that takes him to India via the Himalayas. With his faithful companion Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott, Indy goes in search of the magical Sankara stone and uncovers an ancient evil that threatens all who come into contact with it.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford, Sean Connery and Denholm Elliott. When archaeologist Henry Jones disappears, his son Indiana joins in the search for him. In a desperate race against time, Indy encounters some old enemies and once again finds himself in pursuit of an ancient religious artefact.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: Period action adventure starring Harrison Ford, Ray Winstone, Cate Blanchett and Shia LaBeouf. Nevada in the late 1950s: intrepid archaeologist Indiana Jones finds himself up to his neck in trouble again when he encounters Irina Spalko and a gang of Soviet agents at a military base in the desert. However, this is only the start of a series of adventures that will take Indy deep into the Amazon jungle in search of a mysterious crystal skull.

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Matthew McConaughey and Anne Hathaway. In the mid-21st century, Earth is running out of resources, and humanity is dying. Desperate, former Nasa pilot Cooper comes out of retirement to helm a mission to enter a wormhole and attempt to find a habitable planet to which the population can relocate.

programme.title: Videodrome
programme.desc: Horror thriller by David Cronenberg, starring James Woods. Max Renn is an ambitious cable TV programmer who is a closet voyeur of sex and violence. Looking for something "new", he comes across a show called Videodrome while pirating signals from satellite dishes. The show appears to depict actual tortures and murder. When Renn tries to find its origin, he becomes involved in a bizarre and confusing fusion of television, politics and mind control that seems to herald a "New Order" for society.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

When blonde and bubbly Barbie experiences a series of sudden crises, she must leave Barbieland to track down her human owner and make things right. But the adoring Ken follows her to Los Angeles where he discovers something called the "patriarchy" and develops some radical ideas...

A group of scientists and mercenaries are sent to a newly discovered Pacific island to investigate its unusual fauna. When their convoy is destroyed, the team faces a battle for survival against Skull Island's monstrous inhabitants - among them a certain giant ape.
